text:
release-bot: [deploybot] PAUSED: Helm canary for chart=redwood-inference-api v3.0.0 in eu-central (canary 4%) - increased 5xx and liveness probe restarts after post-upgrade config applied. Canary auto-paused.

emma: what config changed? I saw a values override in the pipeline but not sure which field.

release-bot: diff: values/overrides/eu-central.yaml -> `service.internalProbe.initialDelaySeconds: 5` (was 30) and `replicaCount: 6` (was 3). image tag also changed to inference:v3.0.0-rc.

rui: initialDelay drop to 5 could make probes kill busy pods during cache warmup. Combined with replica bump it may surface startup races. Recommend: do NOT promote the chart. Instead do an image-only hotpatch keeping chart pinned to v2.9.8 for eu-central.

dylan: agree with rui. We can override the probe via --set on helm for the canary, but safer to pin chart and do --reuse-values with image tag only. Also add a temporary `probe.snooze=true` flag if chart supports it.

meera: pin note: I'll set manual pin in releasebot for eu-central to block automated canary promotion. Tagging @dylan to run image-only deploy, @emma to monitor.

meera: pinned chart=2.9.8 for eu-central with comment `pin: avoid probe+replica flip until investigation`.

release-bot: pin recorded. auto-promote disabled for this namespace.

dylan: running dry-run: `helm upgrade redwood-inference-api ./chart --namespace prod-eu --reuse-values --set image.tag=v3.0.0-hotfix --dry-run` -> OK. Executing live to 4% canary now.

dylan: live: canary 4% applied. health: initial restarts decreased, 5xx down to baseline. dashboard: https://observability.internal/redwood/releases/3855556789

emma: monitoring p50/p95 latency and error-rate. If error > 4% within 10m we revert to previous image and lift pin.

rui: also open a follow-up to adjust default probe timing in chart and add CI test that applies new probe values in a staging cluster before promoted. I'll create the PR and tag platform and test infra.

meera: will hold pin for 12h after full promote. plan: 4% -> 20% -> 100% with 10m gates, manual approves.

dylan: ack, will start next gate after 15m stable.

emma: ack. Keeping thread open until 100% and stable for 12h.
